indicators.note: rendering something means turning it into a new form, so these letters are reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone appears hasty in producing a loose translation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rendering' rearranges the letters of APPEAR and RASH.
explanation.definitionFit: A restatement of a text in other words is a loose or free rendering of its meaning.

parts.note: a puff is a short breath

explanation.surface: A bird is taking a breath in.
explanation.definitionFit: The puffin is a seabird with a brightly coloured beak.

indicators.note: from signals that the letters are taken out of the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A sauce poured from a barrel tastes horrid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' takes the letters running through barREL IS Horrid.
explanation.definitionFit: A tangy condiment such as pickle or chutney is called by this name.

clue.text: A title of Tennyson's recognised by the Queen

definitions.text: A title of Tennyson's recognised by the Queen

parts.words: A title of Tennyson's recognised by the Queen
parts.note: Tennyson held the royal post of official national poet, an honour conferred by the monarch

explanation.surface: A title held by Tennyson was granted royal recognition.
explanation.definitionFit: Tennyson held this royal appointment for poets from 1850 until his death in 1892.

clue.text: Work schedule to get over a peak

indicators.note: in a down clue, to get over suggests turning the word for peak upside down

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill or peak, as on Dartmoor

explanation.surface: A work schedule must be drawn up to get a team over a mountain.
explanation.walkthrough: A tor is a rocky hilltop, common on Dartmoor in south-west England; in a down clue 'to get over' flips it upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A roster listing who works when is a rota, a duty schedule.

parts.note: reads like an impression or skit, but describes an erotic entertainment in which clothes are removed

explanation.surface: A thrilling satirical impression is the hit of the evening.
explanation.definitionFit: This kind of performance is a show of removing clothes one by one to excite an audience.

parts.note: pud is short for pudding, a dessert or sweet

explanation.surface: A son takes a sweet rather than a vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: Spud is informal slang for a potato, a common vegetable.

definitions.meaning: ready means set up or made ready beforehand
read as ..., trimmed or pared ahead of time

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition splits the word as PRE (in advance) plus PARED (shaved).
explanation.definitionFit: Something made ready in advance is said to be set up or primed.

clue.text: Cellars where rubbish dumped over ages

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece is placed over, above, the second

parts.note: dung is manure, hence rubbish or muck
eons are vast ages of time

explanation.surface: Underground storerooms where waste has been dumped for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: Dungeons are underground cells, often under castles, much like cellars.

clue.text: Anticipation of gun use when on the run?

definitions.text: Anticipation of gun use when on the run?

parts.words: Anticipation of gun use when on the run?
parts.note: reads like a fugitive fearing shots, but describes a sprinter moving before the starting pistol fires

explanation.surface: A fugitive anticipates that guns will be used against them.
explanation.definitionFit: In athletics a runner who leaves the blocks before the starting gun commits this foul.

indicators.note: eating means one word swallows another, holding it inside

explanation.surface: A ban is placed on eating English seed.
explanation.definitionFit: A bean is the edible seed of a leguminous plant.

definitions.meaning: blue is the colour of the UK Tory party, so a Blue is a Tory
traditional means cautious about change, sticking to old ways

explanation.walkthrough: Blue is the colour of Britain's Conservative Party, so a Tory is called a Blue.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a Tory party member and someone averse to change.

clue.text: Home alone, one slipped into comfy shoe perhaps

definitions.text: one slipped into comfy shoe perhaps

explanation.surface: Home alone, someone puts on comfy slippers.
explanation.definitionFit: An inner sole is a cushioned lining placed inside a shoe for comfort.

definitions.meaning: fashionable means current or modern
so far means until now, to the present

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both modern in style and covering everything until the present.

indicators.note: sort here is read as a verb, to sort or rearrange the letters

explanation.surface: A trade-union style Labour Party branch is a working-class affair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort of' rearranges the letters of LABOUR and CELL.
explanation.definitionFit: Manual workers who wore overalls were described this way, meaning working-class.

clue.text: Character in Hamlet grunted lines out

indicators.note: out signals the letters are put out of order

explanation.surface: An actor playing a part in Hamlet grunted his lines.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges the letters of GRUNTED and LINES.
explanation.definitionFit: He and Rosencrantz are Hamlet's former schoolfellows in Shakespeare's play.

clue.text: Soup from it to fill stomach?

parts.note: to stock shelves is to fill them
a pot, as in pot belly, is a large stomach

explanation.surface: Soup comes from something that will fill the stomach.
explanation.definitionFit: A large pot in which stock or soup is simmered is where the soup comes from.

parts.note: reads as praise for a great seller, but a brilliant is a cut diamond, so this seller deals in gems

explanation.definitionFit: A dealer in gems such as diamonds, which are cut as brilliants.

definitions.meaning: what is needed or essential
informal phrase for cash, the funds needed

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both what is needed and, colloquially, the cash to pay.

definitions.meaning: a result or outcome
a lob is a shot sent up high, so one read as UP plus SHOT

explanation.walkthrough: In tennis a lob is a ball struck high into the air, so the second definition reads the word as UP plus SHOT.
explanation.definitionFit: The final outcome of events is called the upshot.

clue.text: Waits round side of altar for them?

definitions.text: Waits round side of altar for them?

indicators.note: round means the first word goes around the second

parts.note: bides means waits, as in biding one's time

indicators.note: side of picks one edge letter of the following word, here its last

explanation.surface: Someone waits by the altar for the women about to marry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' puts R, the last letter of altar picked by 'side of', inside BIDES. The whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Women at their weddings wait at, or are waited for at, the altar.

clue.text: Designer dress a divine piece of work?

definitions.meaning: a fashion designer's garment is called a ...
God's making of the world

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an original fashion piece and the world made by God.

definitions.meaning: to hold up is to hinder or obstruct
a wicker basket for carrying food

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to obstruct and a lidded basket for food.

definitions.meaning: to guy someone is to ridicule them
men or fellows

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both mocks someone and, as a plural noun, fellows.

clue.text: Part of foundation for big, old building

definitions.meaning: a post driven into the ground to support a structure
a large imposing building, often old

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a supporting stake driven into the ground and a large stately building.

definitions.meaning: brandished, as with a sword
thrived or prospered

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both brandished something showily and thrived or prospered.

definitions.meaning: an expression or name
a fixed period or boundary

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a word or expression and a set period or boundary.

clue.text: It should bring a potential customer to us

definitions.text: It should bring a potential customer to us

parts.note: a prospect is a likely future customer

explanation.surface: A firm hopes its brochure will attract potential buyers.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also defines the answer: a firm's brochure exists to draw in custom.
explanation.definitionFit: A firm's brochure describing what it offers is meant to attract investors or clients.
